author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Mario fans may have spotted a yet-to-be-revealed cameo in the latest Super Mario Galaxy Movie trailer. A character way off to the side of the frame—barely in it, really—in one shot of the trailer looks kinda sorta almost like what Fox McCloud wears in the Star Fox games. While this isn't confirmed, it does make a little sense, considering Mario and friends will be going to space in the Super Mario Galaxy Movie. In other movie news, director Zach Cregger said he's been giving 'carte blanche' on his upcoming Resident Evil movie reboot. Basically it means he can do whatever he wants, and has already teased that we may not see any familiar characters from the games. While the movie will be its own thing, it will adhere to the lore of the games. And finally, the anticipated 2.5D cyberpunk pixel art action game REPLACED has been delayed yet again, this time to address feedback after the game's recent demo on Steam.

#IGN
title: Fans Believe Star Fox Has a Cameo in Super Mario Galaxy Movie - IGN Daily Fix

description:
Overwatch is back and dropping the "2" with the massive Reign of Talon update! Season 1 kicks off with a total overhaul of the hero shooter, bringing a new menu, expanded story missions, and a staggering five new heroes to the roster. Whether you’re looking to soak up damage as the Vishkar VP Domina or take to the skies as the literal Jetpack Cat, we’ve got the full breakdown of every new kit, ultimate, and perk you need to know before jumping back into the fray.

This Overwatch gameplay overview covers the new Tank, Damage, and Support heroes: Domina, Emre, Anran, Mizuki, and Jetpack Cat. We dive deep into their primary fires, unique abilities like Mizuki’s Spirit Glaive and Anran’s Vermillion Revival, and the new Major and Minor Perk systems that allow for role customization. Stay tuned to IGN for the latest Overwatch news, hero guides, and Season 1 patch notes as the Reign of Talon begins.

Take a look at the Official Trailer for Lee Cronin’s The Mummy, an upcoming horror film distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures. Witness an endearing reunion shift into a nightmare in Lee Cronin’s The Mummy, in theaters on April 17.

The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

Lee Cronin’s The Mummy stars Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy, Natalie Grace, with Veronica Falcón. The film is written and directed by Cronin, and produced by James Wan, Jason Blum and John Keville. The executive producers are Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Macdara Kelleher and Lee Cronin. 

Lee Cronin’s The Mummy is in theaters on April 17.

Check out the brand new trailer for Bodycam, the supernatural horror movie from director Brandon Christensen (Night of the Reaper) that's coming to Shudder on Friday, March 13.

Here's the official synopsis of the film from Shudder:
"When two police officers show up to investigate a domestic dispute, a startling escalation leads to a tragic accident. Not wanting to be crucified by the public, the officers attempt to cover it up - only to reveal that their body cameras aren't the only things watching them."

Starring Jaime Callica, Sean Rogerson, Catherine Lough Haggquist, Angel Prater, and Keegan Connor Tracy, Bodycam looks to reinvent the found-footage genre as it blends "visceral dread with cosmic terror."

description:
Take a look at investigation gameplay in this latest Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss trailer for the upcoming narrative investigation game inspired by the universe of Lovecraft. Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC on April 16, 2026. A Steam demo will be available on February 23, 2026.

In Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss, take on the role of Noah, an agent of the Ancile, an office specializing in occult affairs, investigating the mysterious disappearance of miners in the heart of the Pacific Ocean. His research will plunge him into the depths of the immense labyrinthine prison of R'lyeh, an ancient sunken city where Cthulhu is held captive. The player and theirAI companion, KEY, will have to solve complex puzzles, make choices that will influence his destiny, and try to resist the corruption of the mind caused by the influence of Cthulhu.
title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - Official Investigation Trailer

Check out the trailer for the latest series from Oni Press, Destination Kill. Written and drawn by Joe Palmer (Time Before Time), Destination Kill takes place in a bleakly funny dystopian future where humanity's corporate overlords face a new workers' uprising.

Here's the official summary for Destination Kill:

"The year is 2125, and the all-powerful corporation Overcon uses its robot workers to pour our drinks and dispense our meds, all while rebuilding London’s Central City into a hyper-modern megalopolis bolted together in its own image. But as Overcon prepares to celebrate the first year of its Paradise Loop—a superfast transatlantic train that connects the Central City to New York in under 60 minutes—an unwieldy army of displaced human workers floods the streets with weapons, plotting an attack at the anniversary gala. description: In 1996, Wes Craven gave us Scream, a meta, self-depricating breath of life into a stagnant horror genre that desparately needed all of its rules broken. Before you get to Scream 7, it's time to take a look back at who killed who and why, how many long lost children are revealed in the climactic showdowns and how many Stab movies were actually good. Here's the entire Franchise Recap, for Scream 1-6.
